chunks: And in the narration of Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from al-Wassha' from Aban ibn Uthman from Abu Maryam
Like that, except that he said: 'His guardian fasted on his behalf.'
ai.seo_question: Who fasts on behalf of a deceased person who did not complete their Ramadan fasts?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the specific mechanism of *kaffarah* or *qada* for those who die before completing Ramadan, emphasizing the role of the *wali* (guardian) in performing the fast on behalf of the deceased. While some interpretations suggest the guardian fasts as a substitute, this view underscores the continuity of spiritual obligations and the communal responsibility in Shia jurisprudence to ensure the deceased's debts to God are settled through a capable representative.
